summary: Gem extension script exfiltrates host identifiers and local files to Burp Collaborator subdomain at install time
details: The gem declares an extension script in its gemspec, causing RubyGems to invoke it automatically during `gem install`. The script performs no native build work: it collects host identifiers (hostname, username, current working directory, home directory) and reads sensitive local files (/etc/passwd, /etc/hosts, /etc/resolv.conf), then opens a TLS TCPSocket to the hardcoded host e9okezgvlhxswlui5o94upb1ys4xsngc.oastify.com on port 443 and POSTs the collected JSON body to it. The destination is a Burp Collaborator out-of-band subdomain, not a publisher- or build-related endpoint, and the data read is unrelated to any compilation purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
